name: Elementary Benchmark of COMSOL Multiphysics
description: A set of analytical model verification tests used to benchmark and verify COMSOL Multiphysics simulations against known solutions.
evaluation_method: numerical error (relative error / L2 norm) against analytical solutions
general_score_metric: relative numerical error (e.g., L2 or max norm) vs analytical solution
reputation: Widely used internally by COMSOL users and educators for verification and teaching, but not a widely cited community benchmark in ML/AI.
notes: Analytical-model verification suite (non-ML). Small and deterministic; primarily for solver validation and regression testing rather than benchmarking learning models; low contamination risk.
